title: Stubserver library + standalone binary + Docker infra
description:
Implement stubserver infrastructure from docs/plans/17-external-testing.md Section 12.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Key deliverables:
- Add NewHandler(opts ...Option) http.Handler to internal/ai/testutil/stubserver/ (same capture-wrapping handler as New() but without starting httptest.Server)
- Create cmd/stubserver/main.go standalone binary with fixture loading, /health endpoint, X-Fixture header routing
- Create e2etests/external/docker/Dockerfile.stubserver (multi-stage: builder + alpine)
- Add stubserver service to e2etests/external/docker/docker-compose.e2e.yaml (all profiles)
- Create initial SSE fixture files in testdata/fixtures/ (anthropic-simple-response.sse, anthropic-tool-call.sse, anthropic-multi-turn.sse at minimum)
- Unit tests for NewHandler, standalone binary smoke test
- make test passes

AC: NewHandler returns working http.Handler, standalone binary serves fixtures and responds to /health, Docker image builds, fixtures load correctly.
